learning_outcomes.text: Understand the concepts underlying process simulation
Know the range and capabilities of simulation
Create a simulation of a complex production system
Produce and interpret a simulation report

assessment_methods.method: Full development of on-going case studies in working groups of max. 3 students
Full development of a final project simulating a production system in working groups of max. 3 students

assessment_rules: Students are reminded to act with the utmost integrity; any activity aimed at unduly altering the outcome of examinations is prohibited. The mere possession of unauthorised equipment or materials during an examination will result in the immediate cancellation of the exam and a report to the relevant offices.
